findings.finding: Rejected paired evidence mutated the active state before validation.
findings.resolution: Validate the proposed pair before assigning the state; atomic-state challenge passes.

findings.finding: Repair could accept critical evidence before functional reruns.
findings.resolution: Repair accepts an execution pass first; repair-order challenge passes.

findings.finding: Source paths and marker-only synchronization permitted escaped evidence or altered narrative.
findings.resolution: Resolve real paths and compare the entire generated controlling section; escaped-path and narrative-drift challenges pass.

findings.finding: Mirror write failure could leave one roadmap published without its counterpart.
findings.resolution: Preflight reads, retain backups and roll back writes; failure-injection challenge passes.
